name: seasonal-ticker
label: Seasonal ticker
description: A band of big words drifting sideways. It moves faster as you scroll and reverses when you scroll back up; it stays still for people who prefer less motion.

defaults.label: Some of what's in season at the Boulder Farmers Market

template:
{{#each words}}
  • {{word}}
    • {{/each}}
    {{#each words}}
  • {{word}}
    • {{/each}}
    {{#each words}}
  • {{word}}
    • {{/each}}

ai.purpose: A decorative band of big seasonal words that drifts sideways and responds to scrolling.
ai.whenToUse: Between the opening and the first story section, on a brand-coloured band.
ai.avoid: Sentences or real farm names; fewer than five words.
